'''Isen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Isen was sent on a mission to investigate an unusual behavior among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] at a construction site. While investigating, he was suddenly attacked by one of the droids. He barely escaped with his life until he found a transmitter that was on one of the droids. After returning to [[Kaas City]], he encountered an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-aligned individual and explained him the situation. He then sent the individual to deal with the problem and remove the transmitters off the droids.
